class.name: LRTVolume3D
class.description:
Owns one [LRTVolume] and everything around it: it reads inputs from the same [World3D], prepares shared geometry SDFs and per-instance material fields on a worker thread, injects the direct-light source term, propagates the 26-neighbor RGB SH4 transport and draws the migrated diffuse result on the scene's own standard materials.
The probe grid and history live in this node's local space, so a rigidly moving or rotating parent carries them without rebuilding. Scaling this volume or one of its parents is rejected, while collected mesh instances may use arbitrary non-uniform scale. The editor draws the volume box with the same gizmo as a ReflectionProbe. Six face handles resize it, while a seventh handle edits the shared six-face blend distance.
A new volume prepares and propagates automatically. LRT diagnostics are viewport-owned modes under [b]View > Display Advanced...[/b], alongside VoxelGI and Dynamic GI diagnostics. They use the current production field whenever an enabled volume is visible, without requiring selection or placing the camera inside the volume.
External Dynamic GI is sampled one-way from the world's HDDAGI diffuse probe field into RGB SH2 boundary conditions. It never writes LRT radiance back into HDDAGI. Disable [member Environment.dynamic_gi_read_sky_light] while external injection is enabled because this node injects the authored sky independently.

method.name: get_build_stats
method.description: Probe, receiver and timing counters of the last applied bake.

method.name: get_preparation_status
method.description: Returns the current on-demand SDF preparation state, phase, progress, generation and any explicit failure message.

method.name: get_cancelled_builds
method.description: Number of background bakes that were superseded and thrown away.

method.name: get_dropped_builds
method.description: Number of finished bakes that were discarded because a newer one already existed.

method.name: get_error_message
method.description: Last configuration or build error, or an empty string.

method.name: get_geometry_builds
method.description: Number of local fields this node has built and applied.

method.name: get_instance_sdf_resolution
method.description: Returns the instance's [code]lrt_sdf_resolution[/code] metadata override, or [code]0[/code] when it inherits the volume or project default.

method.name: get_solver
method.description: The underlying solver, for diagnostics and parity checks.

method.name: get_sky_radiance
method.description: Returns the Godot environment radiance projected into three RGB SH2 vectors in this Volume's current local frame. This is diagnostic output; production sky transport uses exact HDR samples at the 384 directions of an 8x8-per-face cubemap quadrature.

method.name: get_volume_warnings
method.description: Configuration warnings of this volume, including transform restrictions and ambiguous external Dynamic GI sky ownership.

method.name: is_building
method.description: Whether a background bake is currently running.

method.name: poll
method.description: Runs one frame of the node's own logic immediately: input refresh, a finished background bake and, when unpaused, one propagation round. Scripts and headless tools use it to drive the volume without waiting for frames.

method.name: rebuild
method.description: Collects the scene inputs and starts a background bake now.

method.name: reset_field
method.description: Clears radiance, visibility and the iteration history, and stays paused.

method.name: set_rebuild_suppressed
method.description: Holds rebuilds while an editor drag resizes the volume; releasing it bakes once for the final state.

method.name: set_instance_sdf_resolution
method.description: Stores a persistent [code]lrt_sdf_resolution[/code] metadata override on [param instance] and requests a rebuild. A value at or below zero removes the override and restores inheritance.

method.name: step
method.description: Runs the given number of propagation rounds and stays paused.

members.member: Whether the surface reconstruction weights the 27 candidate probes with the prototype's quadratic B-spline (enabled) or takes the nearest valid probe (disabled, for diagnosis).
Distance from each outer face over which final diffuse indirect lighting transitions from the world's native result to LRT. Zero selects LRT at the boundary without a transition.
Whether final surface display uses the six-face transition. This does not control external Dynamic GI injection into the local field.
Whether the volume also builds and draws while the scene is open in the editor.
Master switch. When disabled the volume stops contributing to rendering and only the engine result is shown.
[code]Color SDF[/code] (prototype default) or the prototype's [code]Analytic boxes[/code] path, which only accepts axis-aligned boxes.
Propagation rounds per frame while unpaused. Zero stops automatic propagation.

Whether the volume reads the world's HDDAGI diffuse probe field outside its six faces and uses it as a one-way incoming SH2 boundary condition. Requires Dynamic GI and [member Environment.dynamic_gi_read_sky_light] disabled.

Longest-axis resolution of shared geometry SDFs for imported meshes. Zero inherits [code]rendering/global_illumination/lrt/default_sdf_resolution[/code]. An instance override set by [method set_instance_sdf_resolution] takes priority. Boxes keep the prototype's fixed 24.
Whether the transferred radiance is reflected again each round (the prototype's bounce term).
Paused volumes keep the field until [method step] or [method reset_field] is called.
Probe spacing in metres: the grid resolution, the h/2 surface band and the reach of one propagation round.
[code]SH triple product[/code] (prototype default) or the [code]26-direction mask[/code] occlusion path.
Size of the probe region, centred on the node's position.

constants.constant: Per-asset Color SDF, the prototype's default path.
The prototype's analytic axis-aligned box path, used for box-fixture comparison.
